All 27 original obligations, twelve displays and three complete solutions retained; exact included programme providers replace stale external paths.
Compact ODE continuation and the actual shifted-curve limit exclude compact half-trajectories without presuming completeness of the original clock.
The full maximal-domain relation map has injective differential and is injective under either supplied nonperiodicity hypothesis.
Return bounds prevent unbounded times; compact continuation excludes missing finite-time limits. The actual inverse image of every compact set is compact.
Finite derivative minors give local graph inverses. Properness gives the continuous global inverse and closed image.
The independent B-to-A argument does not use A: smooth embedded factorization, countably many compact full-rank graph pieces and complete Baire give exactly dimension d+1.
The proper relation gives compact return by interpolation inside each original maximal interval.
Open saturation gives the exact countable quotient basis; closedness separates trajectory classes and proves Hausdorffness.
The relation inverse prevents repeated small transversal intersections. Local finite flow times give actual smooth transition functions.
Subordinate weights have closed supports inside section domains. The zero-dimensional discrete quotient is handled explicitly.
Affine averaging remains inside open possibly incomplete trajectory intervals, is origin independent and smooth; zero extension is justified at every domain boundary.
The global flow map has its exact open interval-fiber domain, covers every trajectory, and has compatible local smooth inverses.
The reverse C-to-A proof retains finite and infinite maximal endpoints and uses the compact endpoint-pair interpolation image.
The positive homogeneous radius is constructed from local products and gives a genuine equivariant product diffeomorphism.
The negative radial integral produces a positive invariant coordinate with its exact inverse throughout the original interval fibers.
Every conic-coordinate symbol derivative is estimated, including the compact low-radius transition interval; no global-in-time bound is asserted.
The complex exponential is explicitly defined; its derivative and inverse give the correct integrating factor and every compact parameter bound.
The forcing integral has the correct sign and zero initial section; compact interpolation controls every base and radial derivative and exact homogeneity.
Full relation trajectory labels (q,s,R) are distinguished from projected labels (q,s); the actual repeated interval-fiber domain proves the relation transport statement.
The characteristic differential cannot vanish; Euler homogeneity and positive radius differential give a genuine characteristic cosphere manifold.
All-real normalization preserves the actual trajectories, and base return bounds lift to compact normalized characteristic bounds.
Dimensions are exact; the one-dimensional characteristic set must be empty. The same-trajectory relation is closed, conic and embedded.
The invariant radius gives uniform endpoint norm ratios, excluding a single zero covector in ambient product-cotangent limits.
The variational symplectic sign, all tangent/time mixed terms, half ambient dimension and negative input kernel covector are checked directly.
Reciprocal clocks preserve full unparametrized trajectories for a real nonvanishing multiplier; symplectic naturality has the precise domain qualification.
The new exact radial-drift model and its rendered diagram preserve all coordinates, section, excluded endpoints and direction labels.

All three original complete solutions remain. Four finite check groups cover radial transport and resonance, symplectic and kernel signs, exact endpoints and a nonconstant change of clock; the full proofs supply the general results.
